properties.Description: The resource-specific properties for this resource.

systemData.Description: Azure Resource Manager metadata containing createdBy and modifiedBy information.

investigations.Description: The list of investigations in the issue

investigationsCount.Description: The number of investigations in the issue

provisioningState.Description: The provisioning state of the resource.

id.Description: The unique identifier of the investigation

execution.Description: The execution details of the investigation

createdAt.Description: The creation time of the investigation (in UTC)

runParameters.Description: The parameters that were used to start the investigation

runState.Description: The state of the investigation execution

completedAt.Description: The time at which the investigation execution completed (in UTC)

impactTime.Description: The impact time to investigate (in UTC)

alerts.Description: The alerts used to run the investigation

resources.Description: The resources used to run the investigation

id.Description: The ID of the scope of the investigation - either an Azure alert ID or an Azure resource ID

addedBy.Description: The ID of the origin - for example, in case of 'Manual', the object ID of the identity, and in case of 'Automatic', the name of the automatic system

addedByType.Description: The source of the origin - Manual or Automatic

createdBy.Description: The identity that created the resource.

createdByType.Description: The type of identity that created the resource.

lastModifiedBy.Description: The identity that last modified the resource.

lastModifiedByType.Description: The type of identity that last modified the resource.

lastModifiedAt.Description: The timestamp of resource last modification (UTC)

filter.Description: The filter to apply on the operation. For example, to filter by relevance, use "$filter=relevance eq 'Relevant'"

value.Description: The RelatedAlert items on this page

nextLink.Description: The link to the next page of items

origin.Description: The source that related the alert to the issue

addedAt.Description: The time this relation was added to the issue (in UTC)

lastModifiedAt.Description: The last update time of this relation (in UTC)

nextLink.Description: The link to the next page of items
